description: Adds context_wamid + text_norm to the parser, and two routes: sos_trigger (whole-message sos/help, any consent state, checked first) and sos_resolution (four labels, attributed by context_wamid in WF-4b).
name: ElderWise WF-2a - Inbound Router

parameters.query: SELECT $1::text AS sender, (e.id IS NOT NULL) AS found, e.id AS elder_id, COALESCE(e.first_name, '') AS elder_first_name, (e.consent_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS consent_requested, (e.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS consent_confirmed, (e.consent_declined_at IS NOT NULL) AS consent_declined FROM (SELECT 1) AS probe LEFT JOIN elders e ON e.whatsapp_number = $1::text AND e.active = true
UPDATE elders SET consent_confirmed_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid AND consent_confirmed_at IS NULL AND consent_declined_at IS NULL RETURNING id AS elder_id, first_name, consent_confirmed_at
UPDATE elders SET consent_declined_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid AND consent_confirmed_at IS NULL AND consent_declined_at IS NULL RETURNING id AS elder_id, first_name, consent_declined_at
